test_title: SSC Stenographer 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 10 Dec, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in active voice.

His finger had been cut by the sharp knife.

options.text: The sharp knife had been cutting his finger.
The sharp knife cuts his finger.
The sharp knife has cut his finger.
The sharp knife had cut his finger.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Passive voice structure: The object of the active voice sentence becomes the subject of the passive voice sentence.
 
• In the active voice, the sentence is: "The sharp knife had cut his finger."
 
• To convert to passive voice: Place the object "his finger" at the beginning.
 
• Change the active verb form "had cut" to "had been cut" (past perfect passive).
 
• Add the preposition "by" followed by the original subject "the sharp knife."
 
• Ensure the sentence structure remains clear and correct.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"The sharp knife had cut his finger."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: **"The sharp knife had been cutting his finger." – Incorrect because it changes the tense and meaning.
 
• **Option 2: **"The sharp knife cuts his finger." – Incorrect because it uses the simple present tense.
 
• **Option 3: **"The sharp knife has cut his finger." – Incorrect because it uses the present perfect tense.
